title: AA v3 Encrypted Device Pairing and Client Trust Contract
description: Out-of-band QR pairing payload (Noise_IKpsk2_25519_AESGCM_SHA256), local client trust records, lock-badge trust tiers (green vs grey), and error codes.

Base64Url32.description: 32 raw bytes encoded with unpadded base64url (X25519 public key or 32-byte PSK).

PairingPayload.description: JSON encoded in base64url inside aa-pair://v1/<base64url(json)>, generated and shown ONLY on the work device (QR code or one-time copyable token). Never sent through the Server.

TrustTier.description: verified_app (iOS / Android / Desktop) renders a green lock; web_browser renders a grey lock explaining that web JS is served by the server and only resists passive leaks, not a malicious server replacing JS.

LockBadge.description: UI lock badge derived from TrustTier: verified_app -> green, web_browser -> grey.

ClientDeviceTrustRecord.description: Persisted locally on the client BEFORE opening the first pairing tunnel (Keychain / Android Keystore / Desktop keychain / Web IndexedDB). Server mode_hint can never clear or relax require_e2ee.

PairedClientEntry.description: Device-side entry in the work machine's local authorized-clients list.
